```{r}
three_to_single <- function(three_letter) {
  aa_map <- list(
    ALA = "A",
    ARG = "R",
    ASN = "N",
    ASP = "D",
    CYS = "C",
    GLN = "Q",
    GLU = "E",
    GLY = "G",
    HIS = "H",
    ILE = "I",
    LEU = "L",
    LYS = "K",
    MET = "M",
    PHE = "F",
    PRO = "P",
    SER = "S",
    THR = "T",
    TRP = "W",
    TYR = "Y",
    VAL = "V"
    # You can add more amino acids if needed
  )
  
  return(aa_map[[three_letter]])
}

aa_alphabet = c("A","R","N","D","C",
                "Q","E","G","H","I",
                "L","K","M","F","P",
                "S","T","W","Y","V")

get_seqs = function(file_name){
  fasta_file <- file_name
  
  # Read the lines of the FASTA file
  fasta_lines <- readLines(fasta_file)
  
  # Extract the sequence information
  sequence_info <- grep("^>", fasta_lines, value = TRUE)
sequence_name <- gsub(">", "", sequence_info)
sequence <- sapply(seq_along(sequence_info), function(i) {
  start <- grep(sequence_info[i], fasta_lines)[1] + 1
  end <- ifelse(i == length(sequence_info), length(fasta_lines), grep(sequence_info[i + 1], fasta_lines)[1] - 1)
  paste(fasta_lines[start:end], collapse = "")
}, simplify = TRUE)

# Create a named vector with one entry
fasta_data <- setNames(sequence, sequence_name)
  return(fasta_data)
}
```

Obtain data on amino acid preferences as a proxy for mutation viability
#viability
```{r}
shannon.entropy <- function(p)
{
  if (min(p) < 0 || sum(p) <= 0)
    return(NA)
  p.norm <- p[p>0]/sum(p)
  -sum(log(p.norm)*p.norm)
}
fname = "flu/fitness_doud2016/Supplemental_File_3_HApreferences_rescaled.txt"
HAprefs_scaled = read.delim(file = fname, header = TRUE, sep=" ",quote = "\"",
                 dec = ".", fill = TRUE, comment.char = "") %>% select(-PI_Y)
colnames(HAprefs_scaled) <- c("H1_POSITION","WT","SITE_ENTROPY","A","C","D","E",
                              "F","G","H","I","K","L","M","N",
                              "P","Q","R","S","T","V","W","Y")
HAprefs_scaled_long = HAprefs_scaled %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(-H1_POSITION, -WT, -SITE_ENTROPY),
               names_to = "Amino_Acid",
               values_to = "pref_scaled") %>%
  mutate(pref_ranked = rank(pref_scaled, na.last = "keep"))
HAprefs_scaled_long
```

##Viability Threshold
```{r}
HAprefs_scaled_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x =pref_scaled)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
                 bins = 100,
                 color="black",
                 fill="white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(HAprefs_scaled_long$pref_scaled, 
                                   probs = 0.01, type = 1, names = FALSE),
             linetype = "dotted")
thresh = quantile(HAprefs_scaled_long$pref_scaled, probs = 0.1, type = 1, names = FALSE)

plot_ranked_thresholds = ggplot(HAprefs_scaled_long, aes(x = pref_ranked, y = log10(pref_scaled))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1,
             linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text(aes(x= 0,#max(pref_ranked), 
                label= paste0(
                  dim(subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, log10(pref_scaled) >= -1))[1], 
                  " mutations above 0.1"), 
                y=-1),
            colour="black", angle=0, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.1, check_overlap = TRUE) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -3,
             linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text(aes(x=max(pref_ranked), 
                label= paste0(
                  dim(subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, log10(pref_scaled) >= -3))[1], 
                  " mutations above 0.001"), 
                y=-3),
            colour="black", angle=0, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.1, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "ranked preference", y = "preference", title = "") + 
  theme_classic()
plot_ranked_thresholds

fname = paste0('flu_amino_acid_prefs_', Sys.Date(), '.png')
ggsave(
  file = fname, 
  plot = plot_ranked_thresholds + theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linetype = "blank"),panel.border = element_blank()),
  width = 3.5, height = 3, units = "in"
)

thresh = .001
HAprefs_scaled_long = HAprefs_scaled_long %>% 
  mutate(viab_thresh001 = case_when(pref_scaled >= thresh ~ "viable",
                                      TRUE ~ "not viable"),
         eff_tolerated = exp(SITE_ENTROPY),
         ID = paste0(WT,H1_POSITION,Amino_Acid)) %>% #compute the effective number of tolerated mutations
  group_by(H1_POSITION) %>%
  mutate(my_shannon_entropy = shannon.entropy(pref_scaled),
         my_eff_tolerated = exp(my_shannon_entropy),
    rev_rank_by_site = max(rank(pref_scaled)) + 1 - rank(pref_scaled), #lower numbers mean more preferable
    my_viab_eff_tol = case_when(rev_rank_by_site <= round(my_eff_tolerated) ~ "viable",
                                      TRUE ~ "not viable"))
HAprefs_scaled_long
sum(subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, H1_POSITION == 166)$pref_scaled)
subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, H1_POSITION == 166)
subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, H1_POSITION == 158)
subset(HAprefs_scaled_long, my_viab_eff_tol == "not viable")
HAprefs_scaled_long
max(HAprefs_scaled_long$my_eff_tolerated)

HAprefs_scaled_long
```

```{r}
fname = "flu/ESM_probabilities_WSN1933_H1_HA.fa.csv"

          -first_letter) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = case_when(
    is.na(ID) ~ paste0(Amino_Acid,X,Amino_Acid),
```

```{r}
flu_DMS_comb_temp = flu_DMS_comb %>% mutate(wt_idx_DMS = paste0(wildtype,H1_site)) # dataframe describing the DMS escape behavior of each mutation. Map between H1 and H3 site indices.
df_Hie_flu # contains the grammaticality and semantic change measures from the Hie model
           # large gramm -> closer to wt -> large rank
           # small sem change -> close to wt -> supposed less likely escape -> smaller rank
HAprefs_scaled_no_entropy = HAprefs_scaled_long %>% ungroup() %>% select(-SITE_ENTROPY, -Amino_Acid, -eff_tolerated, -H1_POSITION, -WT,
                                                              -my_shannon_entropy, -my_eff_tolerated, -rev_rank_by_site) 
                        # DMS fitness data. Large pref -> more fit -> larger rank 
                        # (here the ranks within site have been reversed so small rank is more fit. ignore)
df_stab_ora # ddG from stability Oracle. More negative -> more stable -> smaller rank, more positive -> less stable -> larger rank
df_mutcomp # large probability -> more stable -> larger rank
df_ESM2_flu # probability from masked ESM model -> larger probability -> more grammatical -> larger rank

#anti_join(df_stab_ora, flu_DMS_comb, by = c('ID' = 'ID_H1'))

flu_comb_data = flu_DMS_comb_temp %>% select(-site,-ID) %>%
  full_join(df_Hie_flu, by = c('ID_H1' = 'ID')) %>%
  full_join(df_ESM2_flu, by = c('ID_H1' = 'ID')) %>%
  full_join(HAprefs_scaled_no_entropy, by = c('ID_H1' = 'ID'))%>%
  full_join(df_stab_ora, by = c('ID_H1' = 'Mutations')) %>%
  full_join(df_mutcomp, by = c('ID_H1' = 'Mutations'))%>%
  full_join(df_mutrank, by = c('ID_H1' = 'Mutations'))%>%
  full_join(df_eves, by = c('ID_H1' = 'ID'))%>%
  full_join(comb_data %>% select(c(Semantic.change_ESM2, Grammaticality_ESM2_log, ID)), by = c('ID_H1' = 'ID')) %>%
  select(-starts_with("ESC")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("mutfracsurvive")) %>%
  select(-wt_idx, -wt_idx_DMS)

my_measures = c("Semantic.change_Hie","Grammaticality_Hie", 
                "prob_ESM2_masked", "ddG_Stab_Ora", "prob_MutCompX", "prob_MutRank",
                "Semantic.change_ESM2", "Grammaticality_ESM2_log", "evescape", "eve")

  mutate_at(my_measures, function(x) rank(x, na.last = "keep")) %>%
  mutate_at(rev_rank_measures, ~max(rank(., na.last = "keep"), na.rm=T) + 1 - rank(.,na.last = "keep") ) %>%
```

# Pie Charts

```{r}
library(ggforce)

count_comb_flu = flu_comb_data %>% 
  mutate(tested_via = case_when(
    (viab_thresh001 == "viable") ~ "viable",
    (viab_thresh001 == "not viable") ~ "not viable",
    TRUE ~ "not tested"
  )) %>%
  mutate(tested_esc = case_when(
    (any_ab_ESC) ~ "escape",
    (!any_ab_ESC) ~ "non-escape",
    TRUE ~ "not tested"
  )) %>%
  mutate(tested_esc_via = case_when(
    (any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "viable") ~ "escape",
    (!any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "viable") ~ "non-escape",
    (any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "not viable") ~ "not viable",
    (!any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "not viable") ~ "not viable",
    TRUE ~ "not tested"
  )) %>%
  group_by(tested_esc) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n()
  )

mut_order = c("escape", "non-escape", 
              "not viable","not tested")

pie_data_flu <- count_comb_flu %>%
  arrange(match(tested_esc, mut_order)) %>% # sort so pie slices end up sorted
  mutate(
    end_angle = 2*pi*cumsum(count)/sum(count),   # ending angle for each pie slice
    start_angle = lag(end_angle, default = 0),   # starting angle for each pie slice
    mid_angle = 0.5*(start_angle + end_angle),   # middle of each pie slice, for text labels
    # horizontal and vertical justifications for outer labels
    hjust = ifelse(mid_angle > pi, 1, 0),
    vjust = ifelse(mid_angle < pi/2 | mid_angle > 3*pi/2, 0, 1)
  )
pie_data_flu
# pie_data_flu$hjust[2] = 0 # to get the labels to not overlap since escape makes up such a small fraction of the circle
# # pie_data_flu$vjust[4] = 1
# pie_data_flu$mid_angle[2] = pie_data_flu$end_angle[3] / 2.5
# pie_data_flu$mid_angle[3] = pie_data_flu$end_angle[3] / 1.05

pie_data_flu

flu_esc_pie = ggplot(pie_data_flu) +
    aes(
      x0 = 0, y0 = 0,
      r0 = 0.4, r = 1,
      amount = count,
      start = start_angle, end = end_angle,
      fill = tested_esc
    ) +
  geom_arc_bar(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 1.1 * sin(mid_angle), 
        y = 1.1 * cos(mid_angle), 
        label = count,
        hjust = hjust,
        vjust = vjust)#vjust)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("escape" = "#5D3A9B",
                                 "non-escape" = "#E66100", 
                                 "not viable" = "#AF596E",
                                 "not tested" = "#C5C5C5"),
                    name = "HA\nmutation type",
                    breaks = mut_order) +
  coord_fixed() +
  xlim(-1.0, 1.0) +
  ylim(-1.1, 1.4) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key=element_rect(color="white")
  ) + 
  geom_segment(aes(
      x = 1 * sin(mid_angle), 
      xend = 1.1 * sin(mid_angle),
      y = 1 * cos(mid_angle), 
      yend = 1.1 * cos(mid_angle)
      #y = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) + y_delta, yend = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) - y_delta #midpoint +/- y_delta
    ))
flu_esc_pie

fname = paste0('flu_DMS_esc_piechart_', Sys.Date(), '.png')
ggsave(
  file = fname, 
  plot = flu_esc_pie,
  width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in"
)

mut_order = c("escape", "non-escape", 
              "not viable","not tested")
#layer_data(plot = cov_esc_pie)
```

```{r}
custom_esc_order = (c("escape","non-escape", "not viable","not tested"))
comb_data_scatter = flu_comb_data %>% 
  mutate(tested_via = case_when(
    (viab_thresh001 == "viable") ~ "viable",
    (viab_thresh001 == "not viable") ~ "not viable",

  )) %>%

    (any_ab_ESC) ~ "escape",
    (!any_ab_ESC) ~ "non-escape",
    TRUE ~ "not tested"
  )) %>%
  mutate(tested_esc = factor(tested_esc, levels = rev(custom_esc_order))) %>%
  mutate(tested_esc_via = case_when(
    (any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "viable") ~ "escape",
    (!any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "viable") ~ "non-escape",
    (any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "not viable") ~ "not viable",
    (!any_ab_ESC) & (tested_via == "not viable") ~ "not viable",
    TRUE ~ "not tested"
  )) %>%
```

prepare the data

```{r}
# nested_comb_data_long_gramm = comb_data_long_gramm |>
#   pivot_wider(names_from = "viability", values_from = "rank") |>
#   select(-c(mutant, Starr_esc, Baum_esc)) %>%
#   subset(!(Measure %in% c(
#                           "PyRosetta",
#                           "FoldX")))

data_stats_gramm <- nested_comb_data_long_esc_eff_tol |>
  nest(data = -Measure) %>%
  mutate(
    via_non_via = map(data, ~broom::tidy(wilcox.test(.x$viable, .x$`not viable`)))
    
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(via_non_via),
    names_to = "test",
    values_to = "stats"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    column1 = case_when(
      test == "via_non_via" ~ "viable"
    ),
    column2 = case_when(
      test == "via_non_via" ~ "not viable"
    )
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(stats) |>
  select(Measure, column1, column2, p.value)

y_delta = 0#.25 # distance between adjacent bloxplots (.8/number of boxplots)
x_delta = 0#.185 # distance between line segments
data_comparisons_gramm <- data_stats_gramm |>
  mutate(
    # apply overall false-discovery rate correction
    p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
    # set stars
    label = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    # offset to correct for stars not being vertically centered
    label_off = case_when(
      label == "NS" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ -.04,
    ),
    # calculate x and y offsets for line segments
    yoff1 = case_when(
      column1 == "viable" ~ y_delta,
      column1 == "not viable" ~ -y_delta,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    yoff2 = case_when(
      column2 == "viable" ~ y_delta,
      column2 == "not viable" ~ -y_delta,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    xoff = case_when(
      column1 == "viable" & column2 == "not viable" ~ 0,
      column1 == "not viable" & column2 == "viable" ~ x_delta,
      TRUE ~ 2 * x_delta
    )
  )

data_comparisons_via_gramm = data_comparisons_gramm %>% 
  subset(!(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                          "EVEscape",
                          "PyRosetta",
                          "FoldX"))) %>% arrange(factor(Measure, levels = (x_order)))
data_comparisons_via_sem = data_comparisons_gramm %>%
  subset(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                        "EVEscape"))

nested_comb_data_long_via_gramm = nested_comb_data_long_esc_temp %>%
  subset(!(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                          "EVEscape",
                          "PyRosetta",
                          "FoldX"))) %>% arrange(factor(Measure, levels = (x_order)))
nested_comb_data_long_via_sem = nested_comb_data_long_esc_temp %>%
  subset(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                        "EVEscape"))

custom_order_via = c("viable", "not viable")

x_order_gramm = rev(c("Grammaticality (Hie)",
            "Grammaticality (ESM2, unmasked)",
            "Grammaticality (ESM2, masked)", 
            "MutComputeX",
            "MutRank",
            "Stability Oracle",
            "EVE"
         ))

nested_comb_data_long_esc_temp
nested_comb_data_long_esc_eff_tol

via_gramm_plot = nested_comb_data_long_esc_eff_tol %>% select(c(Measure, viable, `not viable`)) %>%#select(-c(ID_HXB2,ID, any_ab_ESC, res_seq_num, ESC_via_thresh0005)) %>%
  subset(!(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                          "EVEscape",
                          "PyRosetta",
                          "FoldX"))) %>% 
  arrange(factor(Measure, levels = (x_order_gramm))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Measure, names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>% 
  drop_na(value) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm), fill = factor(type, rev(custom_order_via)))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("viable" = "#399c52",
                                 "not viable" = '#AF596E' #"#cd6a83", 
                                 ),
                      breaks = custom_order_via,
                      name = "HA\nmutation type"
                    ) +
  geom_segment( # line segments for significance
    data = data_comparisons_via_gramm,
    aes(
      x = 1.0 + xoff + .03, 
      xend = 1.0 + xoff + .03,
      y = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + yoff1, 
      yend = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + yoff2
      #y = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) + y_delta, yend = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) - y_delta #midpoint +/- y_delta
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data_comparisons_via_gramm,
    aes(
      x = 1 + xoff +.04,
      y = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + (yoff1 + yoff2) / 2 + label_off,
      label = label,
    ),
    size = 10 / .pt, # 10 point font size
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  xlim(-.02, 1.55) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "relative rank", breaks =c(0,.5,1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Grammaticality (ESM2, unmasked)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, unmasked)",
                              "Grammaticality (ESM2, masked)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, masked)",
                              "Grammaticality (Hie)" = "Grammaticality\n(Hie)")) +
  # scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Grammaticality (ESM2)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, unmasked)",
  #                             "Grammaticality (Hie)" = "Grammaticality\n(Hie)")) +
  theme_classic() + ylab("") + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# nested_comb_data_long_gramm = comb_data_long_gramm |>

#   select(-c(mutant, Starr_esc, Baum_esc)) %>%

#                           "PyRosetta",

data_stats_gramm <- nested_comb_data_long_esc_eff_tol |>
  nest(data = -Measure) %>%
  mutate(
    via_non_via = map(data, ~broom::tidy(wilcox.test(.x$escape, .x$`non-escape`)))
    
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(via_non_via),
    names_to = "test",
    values_to = "stats"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    column1 = case_when(
      test == "via_non_via" ~ "escape"
    ),
    column2 = case_when(
      test == "via_non_via" ~ "non-escape"
    )
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(stats) |>
  select(Measure, column1, column2, p.value)

y_delta = 0#.25 # distance between adjacent bloxplots (.8/number of boxplots)
x_delta = 0#.185 # distance between line segments
data_comparisons_gramm <- data_stats_gramm |>
  mutate(
    # apply overall false-discovery rate correction
    p.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),
    # set stars
    label = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    # offset to correct for stars not being vertically centered
    label_off = case_when(
      label == "NS" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ -.04,
    ),
    # calculate x and y offsets for line segments
    yoff1 = case_when(
      column1 == "viable" ~ y_delta,
      column1 == "not viable" ~ -y_delta,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    yoff2 = case_when(
      column2 == "viable" ~ y_delta,
      column2 == "not viable" ~ -y_delta,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    xoff = case_when(
      column1 == "escape" & column2 == "non-escape" ~ 0,
      column1 == "non-escape" & column2 == "escape" ~ x_delta,
      TRUE ~ 2 * x_delta
    )
  )

data_comparisons_via_gramm = data_comparisons_gramm %>% 
  subset(!(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                          "EVEscape",
                          "PyRosetta",
                          "FoldX"))) %>% arrange(factor(Measure, levels = (x_order)))

  subset(!(Measure %in% c("Semantic change (Hie)", 
                          "Semantic change (ESM2)",
                          "EVEscape",
                          "PyRosetta",
                          "FoldX"))) %>% 
  arrange(factor(Measure, levels = (x_order_gramm))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Measure, names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>% 
  drop_na(value) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm), fill = factor(type, rev(custom_order_via)))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("escape" = "#5D3A9B",
                                 "non-escape" = "#E66100" 
                                 ),
                      breaks = custom_order_via,
                      name = "HA\nmutation type"
                    ) +
  geom_segment( # line segments for significance
    data = data_comparisons_via_gramm,
    aes(
      x = 1.0 + xoff + .03, 
      xend = 1.0 + xoff + .03,
      y = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + yoff1, 
      yend = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + yoff2
      #y = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) + y_delta, yend = as.numeric(factor(Measure)) - y_delta #midpoint +/- y_delta
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = data_comparisons_via_gramm,
    aes(
      x = 1 + xoff +.04,
      y = as.numeric(factor(Measure, level = x_order_gramm)) + (yoff1 + yoff2) / 2 + label_off,
      label = label,
    ),
    size = 10 / .pt, # 10 point font size
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  xlim(-.02, 1.55) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "relative rank", breaks =c(0,.5,1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Grammaticality (ESM2, unmasked)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, unmasked)",
                              "Grammaticality (ESM2, masked)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, masked)",
                              "Grammaticality (Hie)" = "Grammaticality\n(Hie)")) +
  # scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Grammaticality (ESM2)" = "Grammaticality\n(ESM2, unmasked)",
  #                             "Grammaticality (Hie)" = "Grammaticality\n(Hie)")) +
  theme_classic() + ylab("") + theme(legend.position = "top")
```
